name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
February 26, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Loretta Gerken, President, Vista Golden K Kiwanis Club
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Waiver of Site Rental Fees for Brengle Terrace Park Easter Egg Hunt (CC)
C4.
Unscheduled Vacancies on the Parks & Recreation Commission and Sales Tax Oversight Committee (CC)
C5.
Policy 700-08, Sale of City-owned Surplus Real Property (CC)
C6.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CC)
C7.
Loan Agreement for Approved Enforceable Obligations (CC/SA)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Loan Agreement with the Successor Agency to the Vista Redevelopment Agency; and
2.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Loan Agreement with the City of Vista.
C8.
Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule (SA)
1.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule (ROPS 13-14A) pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34177 and taking certain actions in connection therewith;
2.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- , approving an Administrative Budget for the period of July 1, through December 31, 2013, pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34177 and taking certain actions in connection therewith; and
3.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- , directing payment of amounts due on item 58 of ROPS lll from an alternative source of funds.
DISCUSSION
D1.
Unwind Agreement for 2011 Real Property Transactions (CC/SA)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving an Unwind Agreement for 2011 Real Property Transactions with the Successor Agency to the Vista Redevelopment Agency; and
2.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- , approving an Unwind Agreement for 2011 Real Property Transactions with the City of Vista.
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Appeal of Planning Commission Denial of PC8-237, Chevron (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
